plan.notes: Official 4-year plan of study published in the Sam Houston State University 2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog (catalog.shsu.edu). Courses, credits, and semester placement transcribed verbatim from the catalog plan grid; catalog footnotes preserved as choice notes. Credit ranges resolved to the minimum (catalog totals are ranges).

courses.title: Advanced Electives
courses.choice_note: Any CJCB, CRIJ, FORS, SCST, or VCST 3000-4000 level courses. Not all eligible elective courses are currently offered in the CBE format. Students in the CBE pathway should consult their academic advisor to identify elective courses currently available in the CBE format.

courses.title: Introduction To The Criminal Justice System
courses.choice_note: CRIJ 2361 is included in the required courses and also fulfills Component Area VIII (Social and Behavioral Sciences) of the General Education Core requirements.

courses.title: Criminology
courses.choice_note: The 120 SCH total includes CRIJ 2362 and one of the following courses -- CRIJ 2364 , CRIJ 2365 , or CRIJ 2367 -- within the required coursework. If a student does not have prior credit for CRIJ 2362 and one of CRIJ 2364 or CRIJ 2365 or CRIJ 2367 , then the total required hours increase by 6 SCH (to 126 SCH). If a student also does not have prior credit for CRIJ 2361 , the total required hours increase by an additional 3 SCH (to 129 SCH).
